title: Arrest gone bad
description: Disappointed with many Jedi Council decisions, a conflicted Anakin Skywalker is easy prey for Chancellor Palpatine's masterful manipulations, which he raises to higher levels as Jedi leaders begin to comprehend this despot's true agenda. Mace Windu leads a small contingent of the Order to arrest Palpatine, but the nefarious Sith is more than ready for them. All are savagely slain save Windu, who engages in a spectacular battle with his now exposed, power-mad enemy. Anakin Skywalker's chance arrival tips the scale in favor of evil, as Palpatine convinces his charge that all Jedi knights are aggressors. Windu is slain by Skywalker, and the unmasked Darth Sidious survives...with a new apprentice...
